title: The never-ending side-dish delivery
about: In a 1988 Seoul alley, five families keep sending side dishes back and forth. A warm comedy about neighbors, a lot like the house in our story.

ko: 끝이 없는 쌍문동 반찬 배달의 늪
koEn: The endless swamp of side-dish deliveries in Ssangmun-dong

about: A conversation built on Talk To Me In Korean's Level 4 grammar. A good check-in at the end of Phase 1.
q: Talk To Me In Korean test your Korean listening

title: Ten hours from Seoul Station to the boarding house
about: A new student from the countryside tries to find his way to a boarding house in Sinchon. The whole drama is set in a 하숙집, just like our story.
tip: The characters speak regional dialects (사투리), so they sound different from the Seoul Korean in your lessons. That's part of the fun.
koEn: It takes 10 hours from Seoul Station to the Sinchon boarding house

title: The new boarders
about: New students arrive at the Sinchon boarding house. Two roommates from different regions bicker all the time.
tip: Strong regional dialects again. Don't worry about understanding every line; listen for the words you know.
koEn: The boarders who will move into the boarding house's single room

title: Little Forest: main trailer
about: A young woman leaves the city for her home village and cooks her way through the seasons. Goes with Unit 17, Grandma's Kitchen.
ko: 잠시 쉬어가도, 조금 달라도, 서툴러도 괜찮아
koEn: It's okay to rest a while, to be a little different, to be clumsy
koNote: The trailer's tagline, from its official description
kw: to be okay, to be fine

title: Dad's paying? Order everything!
about: Five doctor friends order very differently when someone's dad is paying. Restaurant Korean at full speed.
tip: English subtitles are part of this video. Try covering the bottom of the screen with your hand the second time you watch.

title: Owning up to an old confession
about: One of the friends admits, in front of the others, to confessing to one of them years ago and being turned down. Hospital friends, and a preview of Unit 23.
tip: English subtitles are part of this video. Try covering the bottom of the screen with your hand the second time you watch.

title: Chat time: do you sleep well?
about: A relaxed chat entirely in Korean, made for learners, with Korean captions. A step up, so aim for the general idea.
q: Talk To Me In 100% Korean 수다 타임

title: She crash-lands right onto him
show: Crash Landing on You (사랑의 불시착), Ep. 1
about: A paragliding accident drops a South Korean heiress into North Korea, right onto a soldier. A first meeting full of misunderstandings (Unit 22).
tip: English subtitles are part of this video. Try covering the bottom of the screen with your hand the second time you watch.

title: Test your listening: Level 5
about: A conversation built on Talk To Me In Korean's Level 5 grammar.

title: The boarding-house kids take a trip
about: Everyone from the boarding house goes on a trip together. Fits Unit 26, Planning the Trip.

title: Train to Busan: main trailer
about: A KTX train from Seoul to Busan, and an outbreak on board. Heads-up: this is a zombie horror film and the trailer has scary moments.
koNote: The trailer's tagline, from its official description

title: Hometown Cha-Cha-Cha: official trailer
about: A city dentist moves back to her quiet seaside hometown and keeps running into the village handyman. The same seaside feeling as Unit 28.

title: Minari: official trailer
about: A Korean family starts a farm in Arkansas, and Grandma comes from Korea to live with them. Korean and English mixed. A gentle family film for Chuseok week (Unit 31).

title: Ode to My Father: trailer
about: One man's life across modern Korean history, from the war to the present. Pairs with Unit 32, Grandma's Story.

title: A surprise on the golf course
about: The village handyman impresses the dentist and her friends at golf. Sports and showing off, for Unit 33.
tip: English subtitles are part of this video. Try covering the bottom of the screen with your hand the second time you watch.

title: How do Koreans relieve stress?
channel: Learn Korean with GO! Billy Korean
about: People in Seoul are asked what they do when they're feeling stressed. Real answers from real people.

title: Funniest moments of Hospital Playlist
about: Twelve minutes of the five friends making each other laugh. Lots of casual speech between old friends.
tip: English subtitles are part of this video. Try covering the bottom of the screen with your hand the second time you watch.

title: Parasite: official trailer
about: A poor family slowly works its way into a rich family's home. A film about money and class, for Unit 35, Money Talk. The film itself is rated R.

title: Itaewon Class: teaser
about: A young man opens a small restaurant-bar in Itaewon and takes on a giant food company. Starting a food business, like the food truck in Unit 35.
ko: 나한테 뭔 짓을 해도 상관없어. 원하는 거 다 이루면서 살 거야.

koNote: The line in this teaser, from its official description
kw: act, behavior (무슨 짓이야? = What are you doing?)

title: Hyang-mi's tears
show: When the Camellia Blooms (동백꽃 필 무렵)
about: A 38-second emotional moment from the KBS drama. Short enough to replay many times. Practice for Unit 38, Conflict.

koNote: From the clip's title. 쪽팔리다 is slang for 'to be embarrassed'

title: "Because the weather was good"
about: One of the most famous confession scenes in K-drama. Fits Unit 39, where Min-jun finally confesses.
ko: 날이 좋아서, 날이 좋지 않아서, 날이 적당해서
koEn: Because the weather was good, because it wasn't, because it was just right
koNote: The famous line, from the clip's title
kw: to be good, to be nice

about: A reunion on the day of the first snow, from late in the series (spoilers). Watch it after Unit 39, The First Snow.

title: Making it official
about: The two leads finally start dating. Sweet and funny (spoiler for Ep. 11).
tip: English subtitles are part of this video. Try covering the bottom of the screen with your hand the second time you watch.

title: 1 hour of natural Korean conversation
about: Native speakers chatting naturally for an hour. A final test: how much can you understand now? You don't need to watch it all at once.
